Hey — I've exported our order history from Q1/Q2 2024 into a CSV at data/raw/orders_export_Q1Q2_2024.csv. We sell outdoor and camping gear. Management wants to know which products customers tend to buy together so we can set up bundle deals on the site with actual discounts and some catchy 'add to cart' copy.

Can you go through that order file and figure out the strongest product pairings? Then write everything up in a file called bundle_recommendations.md so we can hand it to the dev team and the marketing team. The dev team needs clear logic for which product to push when someone puts something in their cart. The marketing team needs the actual bundle copy ready to paste.

Use the real SKUs from the data — don't just make stuff up.
